verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Consensus serves an llms.txt at https://consensus.app/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It also publishes llms-full.txt and a machine-readable /.well-known/pricing.md. These files carry agent-oriented content, such as MCP versus REST parameter guidance, that an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: per-page markdown versions of the docs (the probe of a .md doc page returned 404), and no independent corroboration of agents actually consuming these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Power agent workflows that need citable scientific sources via the REST API or MCP server
pass `exclude_preprints=true` (MCP) or `excludePreprints=true` (REST API) to filter to peer-reviewed papers only.
API and agent ready: a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app
